verdict.rationale: Grok Bot documents that a named Bot keeps its memory and preferences across sessions instead of resetting, and that you shape a Bot by describing its job at setup (docs-5, docs-2). Duplicating a Bot or sharing it as a template carries that role forward (docs-22, docs-23), and a month-long user confirms each bot owns its own context and domain (comm-2, comm-14). missing for 10: an explicit, documented custom-instructions or system-prompt editor, docs on how preferences are viewed or edited after setup, and confirmation that instructions apply to every response.
